context: Five small, separately testable fixes in one PR. Each gets a regression test. For (4), decide exposure via the existing surface field (get_benchmark_surface) rather than a new mechanism. For (5), default stays anonymize=False for local stdio; remote-authenticated mode flips it on. Watch the fast-lane max_fast_tests cap (_project/config/fast_test_lane_policy.json) when adding tests.
description: Independent defect batch from the 2026-08-04 CLI/MCP review; no dependency on the ADR. (1) benchbox/mcp/tools/analytics.py:195 mis-binds make_not_found_error(result_file, configured_results_dir) -- signature is (resource_type, resource_id, available), producing messages like "Use list_myrun.jsons()..."; pass a literal resource type first as every other call site does (benchmark.py:295, analytics.py:339). (2) validate_platform_options runs twice on the sync run path (benchbox/mcp/tools/benchmark.py:237 and :409); validate once. (3) generate_chart forces ChartOptions(use_color=False) at benchbox/mcp/tools/visualization.py:120 while its docstring at :383 claims ANSI colors are included; keep no-color (protocol-clean) and fix the docstring. (4) get_query_details uses get_all_benchmarks() (benchmark.py:292) so non-public benchmarks are reachable while list_available/get_benchmark_info/resources filter to public -- align with the benchmark visibility matrix (docs/reference/public-contracts.md:88-92). (5) ResultExporter(anonymize=False) at benchmark.py:357 and analytics.py:376 rests on a 'local same-trust-boundary' premise that fails in remote/tenant mode -- anonymize when remote_security is active (thread the server mode through to the exporter call sites).

anti_patterns.dont: fix the color mismatch by enabling ANSI color in MCP chart output
anti_patterns.why: inline protocol payloads with ANSI escapes break non-terminal MCP clients

anti_patterns.dont: widen get_query_details by making the other discovery tools also expose non-public benchmarks
anti_patterns.instead: narrow get_query_details to the visibility matrix
anti_patterns.why: the matrix (public-contracts.md:88-92) is the ratified contract; the leak is the bug

preserves.behavior: Error responses keep secret scrubbing (errors.py scrub_secret_material).
Local stdio behavior unchanged for anonymization; only remote-authenticated mode gains anonymize=True.
generate_chart output stays ASCII-only and inline-only (contract at visualization.py:395-406).

prior_art.concept: get_benchmark_surface public/non-public gating used by list_available
remote_security presence already gates sync execution and tool registration
